# Neopolitan

> Provider-agnostic, headless TypeScript SDK and zero-dependency CLI (`neopolitan-ai` / `@neopolitan-ai/*`) for driving coding-agent harnesses (Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, ACP v1/v2 agents, and interactive CLIs) across local, WSL2, Git worktree, and RPC environments.

## Core Design
- Pure `Promise`, `AsyncIterable`, `AbortSignal`, and Zod contracts in `@neopolitan-ai/core` (zero Electron, Effect-TS, or native binary dependencies).
- Three-tier SPI: `ProviderDriver` -> `ProviderAdapter` -> `AgentSession`.
- Cross-provider continuity via `JsonlEventStore`, `SessionManager.handoff()`, and automatic `redactSecrets()` scrubbing.
- Fail-closed `GateMiddleware` that never auto-approves disguised elicitations even in `full_access` mode.

## Packages
- `neopolitan-ai` (umbrella package + subpaths `neopolitan-ai/acp`, `neopolitan-ai/claude`, `neopolitan-ai/codex`, `neopolitan-ai/pty`, `neopolitan-ai/auth`, `neopolitan-ai/sessions`, `neopolitan-ai/workspace`, `neopolitan-ai/server`, `neopolitan-ai/orchestration` + CLI `neopolitan-ai doctor|run|serve|handoff`)
- `@neopolitan-ai/core`: Core driver SPI, `AgentEvent` union, `ProviderCapabilities`, `EventHub`, `GateMiddleware`, `redactSecrets`
- `@neopolitan-ai/runtime-local`: `LocalExecutionRuntime`, `WslExecutionRuntime`, `killProcessTree`
- `@neopolitan-ai/adapter-acp`: ACP v1/v2 adapter over `@agentclientprotocol/sdk/unstable` with flavor presets
- `@neopolitan-ai/adapter-claude`: Claude Code `stream-json` adapter with env scrubbing & token merge
- `@neopolitan-ai/adapter-codex`: Codex `app-server` JSON-RPC client with surrogate sanitization & hang detection
- `@neopolitan-ai/adapter-pty`: Optional `node-pty` runner with `AgentHookServer` & `OSC 7501` status parsing
- `@neopolitan-ai/auth`: `InMemorySecretStore`, `EncryptedHostFileSecretStore`, `AuthProfile`, `resolveProviderEnv`
- `@neopolitan-ai/sessions`: `InMemoryEventStore`, `JsonlEventStore`, `TurnItemAccumulator`, `SessionManager`, `compileHandoffBundle`
- `@neopolitan-ai/workspace`: `GitWorkspaceManager`, `classifyWorktreeTier`, `AGENTS.md`/`CLAUDE.md` discovery
- `@neopolitan-ai/server`: `AgentRpcServer` & `AgentRpcClient` (HTTP+SSE & WebSocket with `afterSeq` cursor replay)
- `@neopolitan-ai/orchestration`: `FallbackPolicyEngine`, `A2ABroker`, `Orchestrator`, `runPeerReviewLoop`
- `@neopolitan-ai/testing`: `MockExecutionRuntime`, `createMockDriver`, and `@neopolitan-ai/testing/conformance` (`runProviderConformanceSuite`)
